timeline_events.display_name: Cafe clock reportedly stopped two years before Tomas's 1986 statement.
Daniel inventories the railway archive and identifies altered records.
Daniel is inside the station with permits and flashlight.
Token handling precedes cafe clock reset; first encounter, shared tray, and names.
Tomas reports a two-year-broken clock; identity and name-scratch exchange follows.
Counter instability, painful wrist catch, window opening, and forward-aging pastry.
Daniel sends the archival sleeve; Tomas pockets it after reciprocal affirmation.
Flashlight falls; Lilia calls from kitchen; Daniel attends to Tomas.
Two minutes remain; Tomas reports broker and signal failure.
Closing lights, tomorrow promise, notebook instruction, safe fingertip touch.
Cafe closes; aged reply arrives; dust reveals warning; station clock still stopped.
Station fire is recorded as electrical accident; Tomas's death is in the premise.
